CREATE TABLE mo_report_export_job (
	mo_report_export_job_id INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	report_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'mo_division_report', 
	filters_json JSON NOT NULL, 
	include_images BOOL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
	job_status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued', 
	progress_current INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
	progress_total INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
	file_relative_path VARCHAR(500), 
	download_filename VARCHAR(255), 
	file_size_bytes BIGINT, 
	error_message TEXT, 
	started_at DATETIME, 
	completed_at DATETIME, 
	expires_at DATETIME, 
	requested_by VARCHAR(6) NOT NULL, 
	updated_by VARCHAR(6), 
	mark_flag BOOL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 
	PRIMARY KEY (mo_report_export_job_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_mo_report_export_job_type CHECK (
            report_type IN (
                'mo_summary_report',
                'mo_division_report'
            )
            ), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_mo_report_export_job_status CHECK (
            job_status IN (
                'queued',
                'processing',
                'completed',
                'failed',
                'cancelled',
                'expired'
            )
            ), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_mo_report_export_job_progress_current CHECK (progress_current >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_mo_report_export_job_progress_total CHECK (progress_total >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_mo_report_export_job_progress_range CHECK (progress_total = 0 OR progress_current <= progress_total), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_mo_report_export_job_file_size CHECK (file_size_bytes IS NULL OR file_size_bytes >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(requested_by) REFERENCES employees (employee_code), 
	FOREIGN KEY(updated_by) REFERENCES employees (employee_code)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_mo_report_export_job_requested_by ON mo_report_export_job (requested_by)
CREATE INDEX ix_mo_report_export_job_worker_queue ON mo_report_export_job (job_status, mark_flag, created_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_mo_report_export_job_updated_by ON mo_report_export_job (updated_by)
CREATE INDEX ix_mo_report_export_job_requested_by_history ON mo_report_export_job (requested_by, mark_flag, created_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_mo_report_export_job_expires_at ON mo_report_export_job (expires_at)
